entries.type: Powder crystalline concrete waterproofing admixture added at batching (AS 1478.1 Type SN)

entries.reason: No two-component elastic polyurethane crack-injection resin in the Bostik catalogues checked (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Australia, Middle East, Germany, global portfolio); Bostik injection products are PU Wasserstopp (water-reactive PU foam, inj/P1) and epoxy resins (RENO E753 INJECT XTREM, Bostik LVEP; inj/IH).

No one-component cementitious reinforcement corrosion protection / bond coat to EN 1504-7 found. Closest items are different categories: BOSTIK ZRP (India, solvent-based zinc-rich epoxy primer for structural steel, pipelines, tanks) and SBR/acrylic bonding admixtures (Boscocem SBR, BLOCK A350 POWERMIX).

Bostik's crystalline range consists of a slurry (Boscoseal Concentrate / Bostik CWP / Bostik K11 Slurry Grey) and powder admixtures (MIX X510 Boscoseal Admix) - no crystalline repair or cove mortar. BLOCK C583 TERRA LOCK (Germany) is a ready-to-use acrylate-based cove/repair mortar, not crystalline.

No crystalline repair mortar for chased cracks and coves in any Bostik catalogue checked; crystalline products are limited to slurry (Boscoseal Concentrate, Bostik CWP, K11 Slurry Grey) and powder admixture (MIX X510 Boscoseal Admix).

No water-emulsified (water-based) epoxy concrete sealer found; Bostik India lists only solvent-free / solvent-based epoxy coatings (Epoxycoat SF, Epoxycoat SB) and an acrylic sealer (Paveseal SB Clear), none with a TDS.

No crystalline repair mortar for chased cracks and coves found. Mapei's below-grade cementitious waterproofing is osmotic (IDROSILEX PRONTO / Planiseal 88), its repair mortars (MAPEGROUT range) are not crystalline (Mapei brochure 'Repairs to water retaining structures', MK 695130), and its only crystalline product is the powder admixture IDROCRETE KR 1000. The existing comparison uses the rapid plug Lamposilex for the related cr/IM slot; it is not a crystalline mortar.

No liquid crystalline or pore-blocking waterproofing admixture found. Mapei's Ready-Mix Concrete Solutions brochure (MK101030 (GB) 2/26, pp. 31–32) lists only IDROCRETE KR 1000 ('powdered crystallising admixture', already compared in ca/CP360) and the water-repellent admixtures IDROCRETE S ('bulk water-repellent, waterproofing admixture'), IDROCRETE DM and IDROCRETE HP (form, dosage and mechanism not stated; product pages give no TDS link). IDROSILEX is a powder or liquid water repellent for mortars, screeds and plasters only. Mapei USA's Waterproofing Systems catalogue (10/25) contains no crystalline product or integral waterproofing admixture.

Verification only - no new product. No true crystalline / capillary waterproofing slurry found in Mapei's range: Mapei USA Waterproofing Systems catalogue (10/25) describes Planiseal 88 as a one-component polymer-modified cementitious coating (not crystalline); Mapei's brochure 'Repairs to water retaining structures' describes IDROSILEX PRONTO as an 'osmotic cementitious mortar'. The existing Planiseal 88 entry should be footnoted as an osmotic (not crystalline) slurry, or removed from the crystalline comparison.
